On the right side of the image, there are shelves stocked with various snacks and drinks. In the foreground, there is a man wearing a white sweatshirt and black pants, standing in front of a counter with a basket of oranges. He is looking down at the items on the counter. The shelves are filled with different types of snacks, including chips, crackers, and other snacks. The ceiling is decorated with colorful paper lanterns hanging from it. The overall atmosphere of the store is bright and cheerful.
